key_insight: A fully discrete mixed-dimensional scheme couples porous flow, viscoelastic deformation and frictional fracture contact, with proven discrete existence, uniqueness, stability and a priori error estimates.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports simulation of fractured porous materials where fluid flow, deformation and fracture sliding interact.
method: Couple matrix and fracture Darcy flow with linear viscoelastic matrix deformation.
Represent fractures as co-dimension-one interfaces with normal compliance and Coulomb friction.
Discretize using conforming finite elements in space and implicit Euler time stepping.
evidence_signal: A numerical experiment computes discretization errors and compares them with the theoretical estimates.
watch_item: The abstract reports one numerical experiment, leaving broad practical validation of the model unestablished.
paper_title: Numerical analysis of coupled flow, deformation and frictional contact mechanics in a fractured porous medium
